text: Hello! I'm VirtualAssist, your AI assistant. How can I help you today?
Hello
Greetings. How can i assist you today?
When was UJ established, and how many students does it have?
UJ was established in 2005 and has approximately 51,000 students, including 4,200 international students.
What are the campuses and faculties at UJ?

UJ has four campuses: Kingsway (APK), Bunting Road (APB), Doornfontein (DFC), and Soweto. Its nine faculties are Business & Economics, Health Sciences, Art, Design & Architecture, Engineering & Built Environment, Humanities, Law, Education, Science, and Johannesburg Business School.
Can you tell me about UJ's student stats?
UJ’s student body has a gender ratio of 56% female to 44% male, an overall success rate of 83%, and an undergraduate success rate of 86%.
What facilities are available at UJ?

UJ offers smart lecture halls with hybrid learning tech, libraries on all campuses, research labs like the Nanotechnology Lab, 4IR Innovation Hub, and Biokinetics Center, and sports facilities including UJ Stadium (APK), gyms on APK, DFC, and Soweto, and an Olympic-size swimming pool at APK.
What societies can students join at UJ?

UJ has academic societies like IEEE, Debating, Actuarial Society, and Engineering Students Council; religious groups like MSA, Christian fellowships, and Jewish Student Association; and cultural societies like Afro-Caribbean Society, Indian Cultural Group, and Drama Club.
What are some recent events at UJ?
Recent UJ events include ranking #1 in Africa for THE Impact Rankings 2025, hosting a Silent GBV Walk, being a CALTSTEAM finalist, and holding the UJ Hackathon 2025.
How are UJ’s sports teams performing?
UJ’s sports achievements include varsity football finalists, netball silver in 2023–24, rugby Varsity Cup semi-finalists in 2025, and 3 gold medals in athletics at USSA 2025.
How do I register for modules at UJ?

Use uLink (ulink.uj.ac.za): log in, go to ITS iEnabler, select 'Registration' or 'Change Registration,' pick modules, save, pay via e-payment, accept terms, submit, and download proof. Access Blackboard or Moodle within ~24 hours. First-years attend mandatory FYE/O seminars. International postgrads pay 40% upfront and upload visas.
What are UJ’s fees and payment methods?
Fees are ~R3,870 (undergrad day), R6,470 (undergrad residence), R5,560 (postgrad day), and R9,270 (postgrad residence). Payment options are EFT, Credit Card, and NSFAS.
Which learning management systems does UJ use?
UJ uses Blackboard and Moodle for its learning management systems.
What’s the latest news from UJ?

Recent news includes UJ ranking #1 in Africa for THE Impact Rankings 2025, hosting a Silent GBV Walk, CALTSTEAM project as a finalist, UJ Sport Clubs winning 9 medals at USSA 2025, and the Faculty of Education reflecting on UJ’s youth impact.
What research is UJ known for?
UJ leads in 4IR research (AI, blockchain, IoT), partners with WHO on TB/HIV interventions, and has solar energy projects funded by DSI.
What student support services are available?

UJ offers career services (CV workshops, LinkedIn training, career fairs), 24/7 mental health counseling via Student Wellness, and financial aid like NSFAS, merit bursaries, and postgrad scholarships.
How is UJ ranked globally?
UJ ranks 434 in QS, Top 600 in THE, Top 800 in ARWU, and #1 in Africa for THE Impact Rankings 2025.
How can I contact UJ for admissions or emergencies?
For admissions, email myfuture@uj.ac.za. For emergencies, call +27 11 559 1234 (24/7 Campus Control).
What should I do in my first week at UJ?

First-week checklist: collect your student card at APK Student Centre, activate UJ WiFi, download the UJ Mobile App for timetables and bus tracking, attend your faculty welcome session, and register with the campus clinic for free healthcare.
What are the essential contacts for campus life?
Key contacts: Emergency (011 559 1234), Academic Advising (advising@uj.ac.za), IT Support (helpdesk@uj.ac.za, 011 559 2888), Student Wellness (counseling@uj.ac.za).
What transport options are available at UJ?

UJ offers a free shuttle between campuses and nearby suburbs (track via UJ Mobile App). Public options include Gautrain (Park Station, 20% student discount with GoCard), Metrobus, and minibus taxis. Parking permits cost R500/semester via uLink.
What are the key dates for 2025 at UJ?

For 2025: Semester 1 registration (13–31 Jan), lectures (3 Feb–30 May), midterm break (17–21 Mar), exams (12–30 May). Semester 2 registration (7–18 Jul), lectures (21 Jul–15 Nov), midterm break (22–26 Sep), exams (27 Oct–15 Nov). Graduations in April and September.
What’s required for student onboarding?

Pre-arrival: Health Sciences students submit medical records (uj.ac.za/healthclearance), and all register for orientation by 15 Jan 2025 (uj.ac.za/fye). Day 1: collect biometric student card (APK, 8:00–16:00), attend safety briefing, verify NSFAS/refund banking details.
Are there faculty-specific requirements?

Health Sciences requires Hepatitis B and TB vaccinations, stethoscopes (MBChB), lab coats (BSc), HIPAA training, and CPR certification. Engineering requires AutoCAD, MATLAB (free via UJ license), and a mandatory lab safety workshop.
What digital resources should students use?

Must-have apps: UJ Mobile (timetables, shuttle tracking) and Turnitin (via Moodle). Free software includes Microsoft 365 (@student.uj.ac.za email), SPSS (lab computers), and SolidWorks (Engineering labs).
What financial support is available at UJ?

Bursaries include Vice-Chancellor’s Merit (R15,000/year, 90%+ matric) and Sports Excellence (50% fees, tryouts+portfolio). Work-study jobs (e.g., library assistant, lab monitor) allow 15 hours/week during term.
What health services does UJ offer?

The APK clinic (Student Centre Level 2, 8am–4pm) offers free consultations, vaccinations, STI testing, and mental health screenings. The pharmacy provides prescriptions and 10% off non-prescription items. For emergencies, call 011 559 1234 or visit Charlotte Maxeke Hospital (3km from APK).
What resources are available for postgraduate students?
Postgrads submit theses via UJ ETD Portal (drafts 6 months prior, Turnitin <15%, deadlines 31 Mar/31 Aug). Research tools include JSTOR, IEEE Xplore, and workshops on EndNote and methodology.
How can students get involved in leadership at UJ?
SRC elections (nominations 1–5 Aug, campaigning 12–16 Aug, voting 19 Aug online) offer roles like President or International Students Rep. Petitions need 100+ signatures via the Dean of Students.
What are the requirements for graduation?
Undergrads need 360 credits, a 2.0 GPA, and 20 hours of community service (optional). Honours students require a 50-page mini-dissertation and 4 modules plus a colloquium.
What benefits do UJ alumni get?
Alumni have lifetime career counseling, 5 monthly library e-resource downloads, 15% off postgrad fees, and R200/month gym membership (vs. R450 public rate).
What emergency support is available?
For GBV, call 0800 428 428 or visit Student Wellness (APK Level 1). Financial hardship support includes food vouchers and 2-week textbook loans via the Dean of Students Office.
What support is there for international students?
Visa renewals require academic progress reports and bank statements (R60,000/year proof, 4–6 weeks processing). Cultural programs include a Buddy System and monthly 'Taste of Home' potlucks.
How do I apply for admission to UJ?

Undergrad applications (1 Apr–30 Sep 2025, R200 fee) require a National Senior Certificate with a Bachelor’s pass. Postgrad applications (1 Apr–31 Oct 2025, R200) need a degree with 60% average. International students need visas and TOEFL/IELTS. Apply via UJ website or CAO.
What are the accommodation options at UJ?

On-campus: Kingsway (APK, 500 students, R35,000/year), Soweto (300 students, R28,000/year), Doornfontein (400 students, R32,000/year) with WiFi, laundry, etc. Apply via uLink. Off-campus: private apartments (R4,500–R7,000/month) with UJ-accredited listings.
What student life activities are there at UJ?

Over 100 clubs (e.g., IEEE, UJ Rugby, Photography Club) joinable during Orientation Week. Events include Cultural Day, Sports Festival, UJ Arts Festival, charity drives, and hackathons. SRC and faculty councils handle student governance.
What practical info is there for transportation?
UJ Shuttle is free between campuses (track via UJ Mobile App). Public options: Gautrain (20% student discount), Metrobus, minibus taxis. Parking permits cost R500/semester via uLink.
What dining options are available?
On-campus: cafeterias (hot meals, salads), food courts (APK, DFC), coffee shops. Residence meal plans cost R15,000/year (3 meals/day). Off-campus restaurants are nearby.
What IT services does UJ provide?

UJ-Student WiFi covers all campuses. Computer labs offer Microsoft Office, SPSS, MATLAB. Printing is R0.50/page. IT support: 011 559 2888 or helpdesk@uj.ac.za. Free software includes Microsoft 365 and Turnitin.
What’s UJ’s academic structure?

Undergrad degrees (3–4 years, 360 credits) include BA, BSc, BCom, BEng, BEd, LLB. Honours (1 year, 60% degree), Masters (1–2 years), PhDs (2–4 years). Semester 1: Feb–Jun, Semester 2: Jul–Nov, with exams in May/Jun and Oct/Nov.
Can you tell me about specific faculties?

Business & Economics has departments like Accounting, Finance, and research centers like Centre for Entrepreneurship. Health Sciences uses Charlotte Maxeke and Chris Hani Baragwanath hospitals, with Nursing and Anatomy labs.
What academic support is available?

Writing centers at APK Library and DFC offer essay reviews and thesis formatting. Tutoring includes peer support for first-year courses and subject-specific help in Maths, Physics, Accounting. Disability services provide screen readers and accessible facilities.
What does the international office offer?

Pre-arrival: visa, insurance, accommodation checklists and webinars on living in SA. Arrival: airport pickup, 3-day orientation. Ongoing: visa renewal help, International Food Fair, Language Exchange Program.
What career development services are there?
Career Counseling, UJ CareerGate (500+ internships/jobs), and annual career fairs with 100+ employers like Deloitte and Standard Bank.
What’s UJ’s research ecosystem like?
Funding from Vice-Chancellor’s Grants, NRF, DSI. UJ produces 1,200+ publications/year with 3,500+ postgrad researchers. Support includes UJ Technology Transfer Office and LaunchLab incubator.
What’s the digital infrastructure at UJ?
10Gbps WiFi covers all campuses. Virtual classrooms use Zoom and Blackboard Collaborate, with Respondus Monitor for exams. Cybersecurity includes annual training and 24/7 SOC monitoring.
How does UJ focus on sustainability?
UJ has 1.2MW solar panels, LED lighting, recycling for paper/plastic/e-waste, composting in cafeterias, native plant gardens, and bird sanctuaries on APK and APB campuses.
What’s the alumni network like?
Global chapters in UK, USA, UAE. Benefits: career counseling, library access, 15% postgrad fee discount, R200/month gym. Engagement includes mentorship and scholarship endowments.
How is UJ governed?
The Council (external members, staff, students) oversees finances and strategy. The Senate handles academic governance with Teaching and Learning, Research and Innovation committees.
What’s UJ’s quality assurance process?
Accredited by CHE, ECSA, HPCSA. Programs reviewed every 5 years via self-evaluation, external peer review, and improvement plans.
What community engagement does UJ do?
Outreach includes UJ Reading Clinic for primary learners and Engineering’s bridge-building workshops. Service-learning courses like Community Psychology partner with 50+ NGOs and schools.
What’s UJ’s crisis management like?
Evacuations tested twice yearly, with SMS and UJ Mobile App alerts. Support includes trauma counseling within 24 hours, exam deferrals, and assignment extensions.
What future developments are planned at UJ?
A new Engineering Building (2026) with robotics labs and collaboration spaces. Vision 2030 aims to increase research output by 30% and expand online learning.
